        return []

    def d(a, b):

    rcap = {}  # route_id -> load

        routes[rid] = [c]
        route_of[c] = rid
        rcap[rid] = demands[c]
        rid += 1

    for i in depot_nodes:
        dep_d[i] = d(depot, i)

        for j in depot_nodes:

            return False

            return False

        r2 = routes[rj]

            return False
        # j must be head of r2
        if r2[0] != j:
            return False
        return True

        rj = route_of[j]

            rj2 = route_of[i]

            i += 1
